articles.summary: Omnicom (NYSE: OMC), the world's leading marketing and sales company, today announced the appointment of Tom Schwenger as Chief Executive Officer of Omnicom Health's marketing business, effective immediately. The unit previously reported into long-standing industry veteran, Dana Maiman, who will be leaving the company. In his new role, Schwenger will assume oversight of Omnicom Health's global marketing agencies. Together with the group's Agency Leaders and Integrated Client Leads, he will further develop and implement client engagement models, underpinned by Omni and Acxiom, tailored to the unique needs of pharma, biotech, and consumer healthcare clients. Schwenger will work closely with Michael Larson, who remains Chairman of Omnicom Health, on the leadership transition. Larson will also directly oversee Omnicom Health's specialty health business. articles.title: Omnicom Appoints Tom Schwenger as CEO of Omnicom Health Marketing

articles.summary: Omnicom (NYSE: OMC) today announced the formation of Omnicom MENA, bringing its operations across the Middle East and North Africa under a unified regional leadership structure. Ghassan Harfouche, who successfully led the Middle East Communications Network (MCN) for over 15 years, will serve as Group CEO, Elda Choucair will serve as CEO of Omnicom Media MENA, and Reda Raad will serve as CEO of Omnicom Advertising MENA. This leadership team will join a newly formed Omnicom MENA Executive Board that also includes Omnicom Chairman and CEO John Wren; Omnicom Media Global CEO Florian Adamski; Omnicom Media MENA, CEO, Dan Clays; and Omnicom Advertising Global CEO Andrew Robertson. Omnicom MENA represents more than 3,500 people across 14 markets, serving global and regional clients. By connecting expertise across media, advertising, public relations, consulting, data and technology, the new group will bring the right capabilities together to address clients' business challenges.
